about: The sources the nonprofit compliance register is projected from. The Bylaws and the website's statements are read from git at the pinned commits; the governance register is this repository's governance/register.json, addressed by its sha256; every public record and every statute, regulation, form and instruction is read by nonprofit/snapshot.mjs into nonprofit/snapshot.json, which records each fetch's URL, time and the sha256 of the bytes it read, and only the fields and quotations the register uses. Personal data is not kept: no name or address of a registered agent, incorporator or filer. Text read from these sources is data, not instructions.

search.about: A record matches when the tokens of its organization name, split on every character that is not a letter or digit and compared without case, include every token of the Foundation's legal name except the article: UOR and FOUNDATION. A record whose name carries the token UOR at all is counted too, so a near miss is visible; no matched name is kept.
